blocks.prompt: 12 Show that the family of lines given by: \(x\cos\theta + y\sin\theta = \sqrt{a^2\cos^2\theta + b^2\sin^2\theta}\) where \(\theta\) is a parameter and \(a > b\), are all tangent to the ellipse \(\frac{x^2}{a^2} + \frac{y^2}{b^2} = 1\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh saabit (prove) karne ka sawal hai: lines ki poori family ke liye dikhana hai ke har line ellipse ki tangent hai.
Har \(\theta\) par ek nayi line milti hai; humein aisa tareeqa chahiye jo har \(\theta\) ke liye ek saath kaam kare.
Tareeqa: line ko \(y = mx + c\) ki shakal mein likh kar shart \(c^2 = a^2m^2 + b^2\) check karna.
Lekin jab \(\sin\theta = 0\) ho to \(y\) ke liye hal nahi kar sakte (vertical line), is liye woh surat alag dekhni hogi.
Dono suraton ke baad point of contact wala tareeqa ek mukammal (complete) tasdeeq dega.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(x\cos\theta + y\sin\theta = p\), jahan \(p = \sqrt{a^2\cos^2\theta + b^2\sin^2\theta} > 0\).
Saabit karna: har aisi line ellipse ko chhooti hai.
Tareeqa: 6.4.3 ki tangency ki shart \(c^2 = a^2m^2 + b^2\). Lambi equation ko chhota rakhne ke liye root ko \(p\) ka naam diya.

Surat 1: \(\sin\theta \ne 0\)
\[y = -\frac{\cos\theta}{\sin\theta}x + \frac{p}{\sin\theta}\]
\[m = -\frac{\cos\theta}{\sin\theta}, \quad c = \frac{p}{\sin\theta}\]
Kyun: line ko \(y\) ke liye hal kiya: \(y\sin\theta = p - x\cos\theta\), phir \(\sin\theta\) se divide.

Shart check karein
\[a^2m^2 + b^2 = \frac{a^2\cos^2\theta}{\sin^2\theta} + b^2\]
\[= \frac{a^2\cos^2\theta + b^2\sin^2\theta}{\sin^2\theta}\]
\[= \frac{p^2}{\sin^2\theta} = c^2\]
Kyun: common denominator \(\sin^2\theta\) lene par numerator bilkul \(p^2\) ban jata hai. Shart poori hui, is liye line tangent hai.
Dhyan dein: \(m^2 = \frac{\cos^2\theta}{\sin^2\theta}\); minus ka sign square mein khatam ho jata hai.

Surat 2: \(\sin\theta = 0\)
Tab \(\cos\theta = \pm 1\) aur \(p = \sqrt{a^2} = a\). Line \(x = a\) (jab \(\cos\theta = 1\)) ya \(x = -a\) (jab \(\cos\theta = -1\)) hai. Ellipse mein \(x = \pm a\) rakhne se \(\frac{y^2}{b^2} = 0\), yani sirf \(y = 0\).
Kyun: har line ellipse ko bilkul ek point, vertex \((\pm a, 0)\), par milti hai; yeh vertical tangents hain.

Point of contact (doosri tasdeeq)
\((x_1, y_1) = \left(\frac{a^2\cos\theta}{p}, \frac{b^2\sin\theta}{p}\right)\) ellipse par hai: \(\frac{a^2\cos^2\theta + b^2\sin^2\theta}{p^2} = 1\). Wahan tangent \(\frac{xx_1}{a^2} + \frac{yy_1}{b^2} = 1\) yeh banta hai: \(\frac{x\cos\theta}{p} + \frac{y\sin\theta}{p} = 1\), yani bilkul di gayi line.
Kyun: yeh tareeqa har theta ke liye ek saath kaam karta hai, koi surat alag nahi karni parti.

Ek nazar mein
Proof mein har surat (case) ka khayal rakhna zaroori hai. Pehli surat mein humne \(\sin\theta\) se divide kiya, jo tabhi jaiz (allowed) hai jab \(\sin\theta 
e 0\). Is liye \(\sin\theta = 0\) wali surat alag se dekhi, warna proof adhoora rehta. Point of contact wala tareeqa dono suraton ko ek saath sambhal leta hai, is liye woh ek achhi tasdeeq hai.

Natija
Dono suraton mein line ellipse ko chhooti hai. Is liye family ki har line \(\frac{x^2}{a^2} + \frac{y^2}{b^2} = 1\) ki tangent hai.
blocks.final_answer: Saabit ho gaya: family ki har line shart \(c^2 = a^2m^2 + b^2\) poori karti hai (ya vertical tangent \(x = \pm a\) hai), aur ellipse ko \(\left(\frac{a^2\cos\theta}{p}, \frac{b^2\sin\theta}{p}\right)\) par chhooti hai, \(p = \sqrt{a^2\cos^2\theta + b^2\sin^2\theta}\).
